_note: Corporate spoke built 2026-09-14 on Daniel's call, from the corporate demand report. Evidence: two 6,000-person corporate conferences sat in the convention center in one September week, three of the largest Denver galas found all book the Hyatt Regency beside it, two of them used silent disco for the after-party instead of a band, and the DJ is the most common single corporate booking. The buyer is a DMC, a conference hospitality team or a gala committee, so this page is the forwarded proposal more than a search page.
